The superintendent of his building (Luis Guzmán) is stabbed by hoodlums hired by his own rebellious daughter (Melonie Diaz). To top it off, a sexually aggressive chiropractor (Elizabeth Hurley) may just be Ray's undoing.

programme.title: Unhitched
programme.desc: When writer's block derails the literary dreams of Olly Pickering (Stuart Townsend), he has to move in with his friend Murray (Seth Green) after losing all his money. Things start to look up when Olly's college pal James (Steve John Shepherd) asks him to be the best man at his wedding. Prior to the nuptials, Olly is drawn to a woman whom he thinks is the bride's sister -- only she turns out to be the bride, Sarah (Amy Smart). Can Murray, who dislikes James, help get Sarah and Olly together?

programme.title: Man About Town
programme.desc: Hollywood agent Jack Giamoro (Ben Affleck) has a ruthless dedication to his work and a tendency to neglect his wife, Nina (Rebecca Romijn). programme.title: Frontier Fugitives
programme.desc: Ellen Williams (Lorraine Miller) has reason to be worried. Her fur-trader father has just been killed, and it looks like his murderers aim to strong-arm her into giving up the whereabouts of his stockpile of animal pelts. Apprised of the situation, Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) decide to outsmart the crook. Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

programme.title: Riders of Destiny
programme.desc: Loner government agent Singin' Sandy Saunders (John Wayne) witnesses what seems to be a stagecoach robbery, committed by young Fay Denton (Cecelia Parker). But Fay is actually just trying to get her hands back on her own money in order to keep it from thieving stooges Bert (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) and Elmer (Heinie Conklin) and their boss, local land grabber James Kincaid (Forrest Taylor). Saunders then teams up with Kay to fight off the gang and derail the criminal plots of the greedy Kincaid.

programme.title: Stars Over Texas
programme.desc: Cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) have come to the end of a tough cattle drive, but, instead of the rancher they were expecting, they're welcomed by his sister, young Terry Lawrence (Shirley Patterson). It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Rough Riders' Round-Up
programme.desc: Roy Rogers (Roy Rogers) and a couple of his Rough Rider buddies -- Rusty (Raymond Hatton) and Tommy (Eddie Acuff) -- join the Border Patrol. First, they successfully find missing young woman Dorothy Blair (Mary Hart). They then try to track down bandit Arizona Jack (William Pawley). During the chase, Tommy is killed by Jack, and Roy and Rusty decide to cross the border into Mexico to find the outlaw. But Jack has plenty of reinforcements waiting, and Roy and Rusty may be in over their heads.

programme.title: The Westward Trail
programme.desc: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann.

programme.title: Paradise Canyon
programme.desc: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns).

programme.title: Texas Terror
programme.desc: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors.

His loving wife, Olivia (Ann Harding), supports his artistic integrity, but, after the birth of their daughter, she begs Nick to be practical. The resulting strain leads to divorce. Six years later, Olivia, who has since remarried, and Nick, now a successful author, cross paths on a fateful trip to Switzerland. Still in love, Nick strives to win back Olivia's heart.

programme.title: Call It a Day
programme.desc: An actress, a bachelor and an artist flirt with an Englishman (Ian Hunter), his wife and their daughter (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.desc: The wealthy Kilbourne family is tired of Mrs. Kilbourne (Billie Burke) hiring ex-convicts as servants. After a servant steals the family's silver, Mrs. Kilbourne agrees to never hire another drifter for help. But when a rough-looking man named Rawlins (Brian Aherne) arrives at her doorstep, she cannot help but hire him as the new chauffeur. As Rawlins catches the eye of their oldest daughter, Jerry (Constance Bennett), the Kilbournes realize that he may not be the vagrant he claims to be.

programme.desc: Mary (Kay Francis) was relatively well off, until her husband died in the middle of the Great Depression. Now she finds herself with four kids and quickly diminishing resources. She sends the three eldest children to stay with a wealthy aunt, but the youngest boy, Bill (Dickie Moore), remains with her. Mother and son try to make a go of it amidst the gossip and censure of the townsfolk. Fortunately, Bill befriends a rich elderly woman who desperately needs companionship.

programme.desc: New York land baron Alfredo Martino (Eduardo Ciannelli) has started burning down his own buildings and cashing in on the insurance, but he needs a fall guy. He finds the perfect target in Gabe Ryan (Frankie Thomas), a nice kid with a troubled past and a bad habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time. Gabe's big sister, Joy (Ann Sheridan), then teams up with her brother's ragtag juvenile hall pals (The Dead End Kids) and lawyer, Pat Remson (Ronald Reagan), to clear the boy's name.

programme.title: Down in San Diego
programme.desc: A guy (Ray McDonald) and his girlfriend (Bonita Granville) thwart a wartime spy ring at a California Navy base.

They break out of jail and make it to a tiny lighthouse isle, where they take the few inhabitants hostage. But when Champ and Jimbo uncover a Nazi plot to take over the lighthouse, the crooks must choose to either flee or stay put and stick up for their country.

programme.title: Hitler's Children
programme.desc: Anna Muller (Bonita Granville), a U.S. citizen studying at the American Colony School in Germany, befriends both a teacher, "Nicky" Nichols (Kent Smith), and Karl Bruner (Tim Holt), a student at a neighboring school who joins the Hitler Youth. Years after they graduate, Karl returns as a Nazi officer and sends Anna -- now a teacher herself -- to a labor camp. While Karl praises the changes in Anna, Nicky works in secret to help her escape from the Nazis.

programme.title: Youth Runs Wild
programme.desc: The teens of a defense-plant town hop on the road to juvenile delinquency while their parents are busy with the war.

Despite the warnings of her dad (John Litel) and her pal Ted (Frankie Thomas), Nancy can't stop herself from investigating.
